warlock__root.title: Eldritch Blast
warlock__root.description: Unlocks Eldritch Blast (Level 3) (91 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__root.extra_description: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy. The first skill of the Warlock base.

warlock__constitution_mastery_i.title: Constitution Mastery I
warlock__constitution_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__sonic_boom.title: Sonic Boom
warlock__sonic_boom.description: Unlocks Sonic Boom (Level 1) (83 mana, 37.41 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__sonic_boom.extra_description: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

warlock__constitution_2.title: Constitution 2
warlock__constitution_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__orbital_void.title: Orbital Void
warlock__orbital_void.description: Unlocks Orbital Void (Level 3) (91 mana, 37.41 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__orbital_void.extra_description: Shoots Abyssal Orb projectiles in a circular pattern around the player, damaging entities. On the initial cast, Abyssal Orbs home in on nearby entities.

warlock__violent_skreech.title: Paralyzing Skreech
warlock__violent_skreech.description: Unlocks Paralyzing Skreech (Level 3) (11 mana, 37.41 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__violent_skreech.extra_description: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.

warlock__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
warlock__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__wellspring_3.title: Wellspring 3
warlock__wellspring_3.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__reservoir_1.title: Reservoir 1
warlock__reservoir_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__voodoo_magic.title: Voodoo Magic
warlock__voodoo_magic.description: Teaches Voodoo Magic, an Epic Fight Identity skill: Losing health restores half as much stamina and losing stamina half as much health; sneak to turn health into stamina; stamina no longer regenerates on its own. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__wellspring_mastery_ii.title: Wellspring Mastery II
warlock__wellspring_mastery_ii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
warlock__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__sculk_tentacles.title: Sculk Tentacles
warlock__sculk_tentacles.description: Unlocks Sculk Tentacles (Level 1) (113 mana, 44.89 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__sculk_tentacles.extra_description: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

warlock__planar_sight.title: Planar Sight
warlock__planar_sight.description: Unlocks Planar Sight (Level 1) (113 mana, 199.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__planar_sight.extra_description: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

warlock__reservoir_mastery_iii.title: Reservoir Mastery III
warlock__reservoir_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__magic_sword.title: Magic Blade
warlock__magic_sword.description: Teaches Magic Blade, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Automatically casts the currently selected spell when a weapon swing ends. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__abyssal_orbs.title: Abyssal Orbs
warlock__abyssal_orbs.description: Unlocks Abyssal Orbs (Level 3) (30 mana, 14.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__abyssal_orbs.extra_description: Summons several abyssal orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies with direct impact.

warlock__counterspell.title: Counterspell
warlock__counterspell.description: Unlocks Counterspell (Level 1) (38 mana, 14.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__counterspell.extra_description: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

warlock__psychic_bolt.title: Psychic Bolt
warlock__psychic_bolt.description: Unlocks Psychic Bolt (Level 3) (68 mana, 59.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__psychic_bolt.extra_description: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.

warlock__against_magic.title: Magic Immunity
warlock__against_magic.description: Teaches Magic Immunity, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Grants extremely high magic resistance. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__abyssal_shroud.title: Abyssal Shroud
warlock__abyssal_shroud.description: Unlocks Abyssal Shroud (Level 1) (227 mana, 199.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__abyssal_shroud.extra_description: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

warlock__wellspring_2.title: Wellspring 2
warlock__wellspring_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

warlock__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
warlock__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

warlock__planned_sculk_watcher.title: Summon Sculk Watcher
warlock__planned_sculk_watcher.description: Unlocks Summon Sculk Watcher (50 mana, 90 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
warlock__planned_sculk_watcher.extra_description: Summon a small sculk creature that blinds and sonic-pulses nearby enemies.

warlock__black_hole.extra_description: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

warlock__shadowed_miasma.extra_description: Inflicts nearby enemies with the abyssal curse effect and infuses your weapon with the same curse. Dealing damage to an enemy during the effect has a chance to spread the effect to nearby enemies.

warlock__end_mayhem.extra_description: This spell allows you to become the ruler of the end while casting it, allowing you to use the full power of the end dimension to kill your target.
